function_ranges.role: Retained fraction witness levels, 3-multiply recurrence, reusable buffers, sqrt-Eq evaluation and folded layer prover
Rational root equality and sequential left/right fraction reductions
Square-root Eq evaluation with virtual constant padding and deferred reductions
Equality-factored two-statistic product sumcheck with in-place folds
Point reversal at low-first public boundary
Retained suffix equality-table layout; unused alloc helpers omitted
Endpoint recovery and equality-product relation check
Quadratic IP proving and terminal committed evaluation
Index encoding injects bits as polynomial coefficients

local_adaptations: K/U256 static field shim replaces F128/Wide256 without changing field basis or arithmetic formulas.
Typed proof structs and checked dimensions/round/layer counts replace donor stream deserialization.
Result errors replace invalid-input root/shape/denominator and zero-gamma assertions; terminal IP validation adds no full-table scan.
OM hash-chain transcript uses explicit label/domain/dimension and canonical field-message framing; this is a new wire format, not original-proof-byte compatibility.
Donor product loop retains high-variable-first scheduling and boundary reversals; every public point is OM low-variable-first.
Unused upstream grand-product orchestration, tracing attributes and standalone allocation helpers omitted.
Independent dense algebra/proof/transcript oracles added for native/default regression coverage.
protocol_scope: Weighted rational pushforward and public-table inner-product reductions only. Caller must commit weighted pushforward before tau and authenticate every returned nonpublic evaluation.
shared_dependencies: om-field and om-transcript provenance is recorded separately in vendor/open-magnetar/UPSTREAM.json; rayon is resolved by the caller Cargo lockfile.
fingerprint_scope: Cargo.toml, LICENSE, and every src file (including tests); excludes Cargo.lock, provenance/docs and target outputs.
fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256 over sorted UTF-8 relative path + NUL + raw 32-byte file SHA256 for each local_sha256 entry.
